title: Meeting productivity tool
summary: Make meetings shorter and more productive.
whyItFails: Behaviour change. Tools don't change culture. Bundled. Zoom and Teams add features. Low urgency. Meetings persist.
whatWouldChange: AI notes and actions built in.
